Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Unsubscribe buttons now say how they'll unsubscribe — one-click, by email, or a web link — so you know before clicking. Hover for the address or site.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • In Subscriptions, click a sender to open their latest email, so you can see what it is before unsubscribing.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Improvements

  • Faster all round. Clicking between emails, opening them and scrolling the list do much less work, and background mail checks no longer redraw the window when nothing changed.
  • Fewer pauses. Mail from Gmail is now processed in the background, along with the hourly sign-in refresh, so the window doesn't stall while they run.
  • Opens faster. The mail window appears without waiting on a startup check.
  • Search results open right away, showing the conversation while its messages finish loading.
  • Collapsing and re-opening a message is instant, and pictures inside emails, such as logos in signatures, load faster and aren't downloaded again.
  • Move the "While you were away" card by dragging its header.

Bug fixes

  • The first click into To or Cc in a reply now puts the cursor there. Before, typing and Backspace could go to the message body instead.
  • What's New shows every note, including ones that were missing from earlier versions.
  • Replying from a notification always replies to the full message.
  • The "New" sender badge no longer wraps onto two lines in a narrow message list.
  • Spotlight (if turned on) no longer keeps conversations you've moved to the Trash.
